# Visual Property Ownership Ledger

**Status**: Canonical T2 migration ledger; T2 COMPLETE

This ledger records current production sources and approved target ownership. It
does not make the target APIs in `03_THEME_SYSTEM.md` current, expose them early,
or supersede the implemented contracts in `01_ARCHITECTURE.md` and
`02_RENDERING_CONTRACT.md`. Target names below are migration assignments only
until Phase T6 performs the atomic public migration.

The ledger is append-only during T2 except for corrections and T2h
reconciliation. Tests, examples, and snapshots are evidence consumers, never
independent property sources.

## Record Protocol

One property record may be physically split across the keyed current-state,
target-state, and migration/evidence tables below. The same unique `Property`
key joins every required field from the T2 schema in
`91_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md`: source and value, consumers, current behavior,
layout path, semantic role, target class and owner, target resolution, target
validation, public surface, relationships, audit evidence, disposition and
phase, and visual evidence. A key present in only some physical tables is an
incomplete record.

The closed target classes are exactly `Theme component`, `Theme data scale`,
`Plot-local data scale`, `Exact element style`, `Explicit policy`, and
`Renderer invariant`. Completed T2a sections use no unresolved values and
introduce no future public names beyond the T1 types.

The named relationship set `theme-preset-property-keys` contains exactly these
property keys:

`color-scales.qualitative.current-theme-colors`,
`marks.accent.current-theme-colors`,

## Preset Value Reference

`P`, `N`, `S`, and `C` mean Publication, Nature, Science, and CHI. RGB values are
opaque `(u8, u8, u8)` tuples. Widths and lengths are current SVG/CSS pixels.
Font-size documentation says points, but current layout treats each `u32` as a
pixel-like value and SVG emits an unqualified `font-size`; the records preserve
that current unit mismatch.

## Current Resolution And Consumer References

The compact codes in the record table expand as follows and are part of each
record that cites them.

| B-PAL | `Plot` stores mandatory `Theme`, defaults to `Theme::Publication` at `builder.rs:455,542`, and replaces it through `builder/configuration.rs:321-325`. `Plot::palette()` at `builder/layout.rs:8-13` rebuilds an owned `ThemePalette`, including `Vec` and `String`, on every read. Canvas has no theme and reconstructs Publication at `canvas.rs:584,935`; headers/row titles may instead use the first Plot palette at `canvas.rs:657-662,936-941`. No palette construction validation or fallback exists. |
| B-TEXT | Deterministic measurement consumes text and numeric size, not family or installed faces. Preserve-text SVG emits the family expression. Outlined SVG and PNG resolve host fonts only after canonical SVG layout. `TextStyle` validates rotation only, not family or size. |
| B-WIDTH | A used line/bracket width is checked only at the backend boundary for finite nonnegative values. Palette construction and dormant widths are unchecked. |
| C-route | Direct production consumers are `theme.rs:5`, `builder/layout.rs:11-13`, mandatory/default/setter storage at `builder.rs:455,542` and `builder/configuration.rs:323-325`, and hidden Canvas calls at `canvas.rs:584,935`; all field consumers below are transitive consumers. |

## Reconciliation

- The completed T2a1 count is exactly **65**. Every key appears once in each of
  the current-state, target-state, and migration/evidence tables.
- Independent ownership review found that five of the initial 57 rows combined
  distinct target owners: tick-label policy, palette font stack, palette text
  foreground, and Canvas title-size contexts. Replacing those five rows with 13
  exact-owner rows increased the reconciled count by eight without discovering
  another production source.
- The public preset selector remains a classification boundary. The ledger
  classifies only its deterministic one-preset-to-one-complete-Theme dispatch as
  a private renderer invariant. Every selected visual value remains exclusively
  in the split component or scale records.
- `ThemePalette::colors`, `font_family`, `background`, `foreground`,
  `axis_width`, and the multi-role typography sizes remain physically separate
  records where their target semantics, resolution scopes, or owners differ.
- `background` and `line_width` are dormant; `show_top_right_spines` is miswired;
  `show_ticks`, `show_tick_labels`, `show_x_label`, and `show_y_label` are
  partially wired. Their dispositions preserve rather than conceal those facts.
- Equal preset literals are shared only through `PV`; they are not treated as
  evidence that independent target roles have one owner.
- Every direct palette font-stack read and every palette-foreground read is
  partitioned by target role. Shared renderer reads use disjoint Plot/Canvas or
  text/stroke call contexts rather than duplicate target ownership.
- No target owner, public surface, relationship, validation, phase, or evidence
  field is `TBD`, `unknown`, or `other`. No unapproved future public type name is
  introduced.

## Existing Evidence

Useful evidence consumers include the theme tests in M9,
`tests/visual_regression`, `tests/layout/layout_and_legends.rs`,
`tests/rendering/public_contracts.rs:168-185`, and
`tests/annotations/panel_text.rs:39-69`. They do not own ledger records. Exact
full-preset snapshots for Nature, Science, and CHI remain required by the
migration evidence above; T2a1 does not create or update them.

selected by plots, layouts, legends, annotations, or scales and merely carried
through these types remain consumer references owned by later T2 subphases.

### T2a2 Reconciliation

- The completed T2a2 count is exactly **52**. Every descriptive key appears
  once in each keyed current-state, target-state, and migration/evidence table.
- T2a1 and T2a2 contain exactly **117 completed T2a records**. T2a3 brought the
  completed count to 162; T2a4 source reconciliation corrects and completes the
  four-part T2a plan at **222 records**.
- Source reconciliation required no net split correction to the initial 52.
  The multi-owner `BracketStyle::color` source is already represented by
  `backend.bracket.combined-color-stroke-meaning` and
  `backend.bracket.combined-color-text-meaning`. Other grouped declarations have
  one target class, owner, and owning migration phase.
- RGB-plus-separate-opacity fields remain explicit current defects rather than
  being mistaken for RGBA. Point, line, fill, text, outline, bracket, and
  gradient carriers each have one final private-boundary responsibility.
- No plot, layout, legend, annotation-content, or scale value merely passed
  through a carrier is assigned to T2a2. Significance metric literals are owned
  only because A2-M4 declares those executable defaults.
- No target field is unresolved and no future public type name is introduced.
  Component owners are limited to T1-approved types; private responsibilities
  use descriptive renderer-invariant names.

## T2a3: Serialization, Geometry Recording, And Scene Conversion

This section owns concrete SVG serialization, PNG paint/alpha serialization,
geometry-obstacle recording, immutable scene reuse, and scene conversion-limit
sources in `src/render.rs`, `src/render/svg_backend.rs`,
`src/render/geometry.rs`, and `src/scene.rs`. T2a2 remains the sole owner of
abstract backend carriers, validation, and protocol declarations. T2a4 owns PNG
sizing, options, transforms, compression, DPI metadata, format-local output
timing, and artifact publication even where those contexts live in
`svg_backend.rs`.

- The completed T2a3 count is exactly **45**: 20 SVG records, including the PNG
  RGBA8 paint/alpha boundary, 15 Geometry records, and 10 Scene records. Every
  descriptive key appears once in each keyed table in the same order.
- The initial 36 became 45 without discovering a new production source: SVG
  changed from 22 to 20 (`-2`) after PNG sizing/output ownership moved to T2a4,
  Geometry changed from 11 to 15 (`+4`) after lifecycle and path/text bounds
  were separated, and Scene changed from 3 to 10 (`+7`) after routes, positive
  checks, and four independent limit declarations were separated, for a net
  correction of `+9`.
- T2a1, T2a2, and T2a3 complete exactly **162 records**. Their then-current
  202-record four-part estimate assigned 40 records to T2a4; T2a4 source
  reconciliation below supersedes that estimate with **222 records**: 65 T2a1,
  52 T2a2, 45 T2a3, and 60 T2a4.
- `backend.svg.incomplete-per-paint-alpha-serialization` is the sole private
  paint-property placement and alpha-routing responsibility and remains owned by
  T5a. T2a1 `backend.svg.rgb-hex-serialization` now owns only deterministic
  color-channel/token spelling; T5c, T5d, and T6 complete annotation, scale,
  carrier, and public inputs without duplicating either source.
- The concrete SVG lifecycle remains T2a3 because it is executable serializer
  state-machine behavior. T2a2 owns the abstract lifecycle contract, while T2a4
  owns orchestration and artifact publication.
- Independent review corrected post-format geometry collapse and stale SVG
  output, made point/polygon joins explicit, made collision bounds paint-aware,
  connected dormant Geometry lifecycle methods to decoration planning, scoped
  maximum Scene limits to PNG, deduplicated positive source dimensions into
  canonical scene construction, and required exact generic/bracket whitespace
  preservation without changing the key set.
- Bracket path serialization/bounds migrate in T5c; bracket label
  serialization/bounds migrate in T5a. Equal Scene limits with independent
  declarations remain independent records.
- Source reconciliation and identical key-count/order checks passed; final
  independent ownership review found no remaining semantic or schema issue.
  Tracked-diff checks and `just verify` passed on 2026-08-26. No production code,
  tests, snapshots, or other specifications changed in T2a3.

## T2a4: Lifecycle, Output, And Artifact Foundations

This completed section owns Plot lifecycle and sequencing, concrete
Deferred and Null backend behavior, terminal-output policy and timing, artifact
staging, and PNG options, sizing, transforms, compression, metadata, and encoder
lifecycle. It includes the exact deferred PNG expression contexts in
`src/render/svg_backend.rs` and the exact public PNG policy declarations in
`src/spec/output.rs`. T2a1 through T2a3 remain the sole owners of palette values,
abstract backend protocol and validation, SVG/PNG paint serialization, immutable
scene routes, and Scene resource-limit declarations.

- The completed T2a4 count is exactly **60**: 13 Plot lifecycle and sequencing
  records, 10 Deferred/null backend records, 15 output-routing and
  publication-timing records, 7 artifact records, and 15 PNG
  option/sizing/encoding records. Every descriptive key appears once in each
  keyed table in the same order.
- The corrected and completed T2a aggregate is exactly **222**: 65 T2a1, 52
  T2a2, 45 T2a3, and 60 T2a4 records.
- Independent review findings corrected the T2a4/T2b PNG declaration boundary,
  both reconstruction contexts, explicit Deferred end state, Null lifecycle and
  migration phasing, Windows backup failure paths, exact PNG rounding and
  metadata ordering, and panel category-order validation timing. These
  corrections changed no keyed-record count or order.
- The superseded 40-record estimate changed without new production scope.
  Source adjudication separated independent Plot/Output terminal selections,
  preflight/plan/render timing, Null terminal policies, conversion-before-stage
  timing, artifact failure/cleanup paths, and the five exact public PNG policy
  declarations. It retained one Deferred state-machine record because those
  contexts share one semantic role, target owner, and T3 phase.
- PNG sizing/options are expressly T2a4-owned even though their declarations are
  public. T2b expressly excludes `src/spec/output.rs:3-52`; only the public PNG
  type re-exports at `src/spec.rs:26` and `src/lib.rs:75` remain T2b-owned, while
  `src/spec.rs:25` is crate-private transport. This keeps the manifests disjoint.
- Windows existing-file publication is currently non-atomic because it renames
  the destination to one unreserved backup candidate before installing staged
  bytes, creating an absence window and depending on fallible rollback and
  hidden cleanup. The target contract is one true atomic same-directory
  replacement that preserves the old destination on every failure;
  `artifact.windows-publication` is therefore `replace`, T3.
- No Canvas source record is admitted. `canvas.rs:390-430` remains T2d-owned and
  `canvas.rs:432-464` is assigned to completed T2h H-M1.
- A post-correction independent rereview found no remaining semantic, schema,
  ownership, phase, count, or order issue. Tracked-diff checks and `just verify`
  passed on 2026-08-26. No production code, tests, snapshots, or other
  specifications changed in T2a4.

### T2b Migration And Evidence

The compact evidence codes below name required migration evidence. They do not
claim that a future implementation check already exists or passed.

| Code | Required visual or contract evidence |
| --- | --- |
| B-V-P | No output change expected; focused public-policy construction, default, setter, preflight, and representative snapshot assertions are required. |
| B-V-C | No output change expected; exact compile-pass and compile-fail family matrices, plus erased-runtime parity where applicable, are required. |
| B-V-G | No output change expected; focused valid geometry plus every independent invalid topology, support, positivity, and resource branch are required. |
| B-V-E | No ordinary valid-output change expected; focused exact-style precedence, validation, legend-glyph, and representative SVG assertions are required. |
| B-V-I | No output change expected; focused private invariant/preflight failure and successful render parity assertions are required. |
| B-V-D | Intentional custom-theme or scale redesign with unchanged built-in semantic intent; focused resolution, precedence, SVG, Canvas, and scale snapshots are required. |
| B-V-F | Intentional earlier or stricter validation correction; focused failure-timing and no-backend-output assertions are required. |

  invariant**, **19 Exact element style**, **4 Plot-local data scale**, **6 Theme

- The corrected source-derived T2e inventory is exactly **203** records.

  8 E-M6, 38 E-M7, 20 E-M8, 26 E-M9, 9 E-M10, 4 E-M11, 8 E-M12, 3 E-M13, and 1
  E-M14.

  policy**, and **138 Renderer invariant** records. Theme data scale, Plot-local
  data scale, and Exact element style each have zero T2e records; no row uses an
  unapproved class or multiple classes. Theme owners are only approved
  `MarkTheme`, `TypographyTheme`, and non-text-geometry `AnnotationTheme` roles.

  ratio defaults are `MarkTheme` appearance components. Other body/cloud widths,

  State, and once in Migration And Evidence, in identical 203-key
  source order. Manifest, compact-reference, prior-owned, deferred, rejected,
  and reconciliation tables are non-keyed audit context and add no records.
- T2a1 remains the sole source owner for `ThemePalette` fields and preset
  literals; T2a2-T2a4 remain the carrier/backend/serialization/lifecycle owners.
  T2b remains the sole owner of public declarations, exact fields,
  visibility/presence, and policy declarations. E-M13 private conversion and all
  private materialization/final application rows are Renderer invariants, not
  new Exact-element-style records.
- T2c remains the owner of generic layout, ranges/projection, axes/ticks, and
  horizontal-bar label planning. The omitted
  `src/plots/horizontal_bar.rs:409-548` block is an explicit T2h reconciliation
  finding against the completed T2c manifest; it contributes no T2e record.
  T2d remains the legend representation/layout/equality/collision owner. T2e
  owns originating mark styles and exact final-style reuse or reconstruction at
  renderer call sites. T2f/T2g retain the specialized annotation and semantic
  data-color sources described above.
- Ordinary bar orientation remains explicit: vertical single/stacked width
  `0.6` and grouped span `0.76` differ from horizontal height `0.55` and grouped
  span `0.74`. Body and supplemental-point centers, rectangle and uncertainty
  topology, outline width, alpha, pattern, and final assembly/reuse remain
  separate records. Plain/no-outline BarPointLayer values extend ordinary ranges
  center-only; radius is consumed by T2f significance clearance and backend
  collision geometry without expanding ordinary range/clipping. Current
  interval-bearing bar range folding validates but omits the rendered end, and
  T5c corrects that omission. T2f wholly owns significance maxima, clearance,
  second anchored ranges, centers/spans, planning, drawing, and collision; T2e
  retains only each initial zero anchor and ordinary order around an interleaved
  T2f draw.
- Originating legend styles commonly reconstruct instead of reusing final marks:
  bars, boxplots, density, violin/raincloud, ordinary line series, and grouped
  paths each retain separate source records and duplicate-cluster relationships.
  T2h fixes final mark styles as sole target owners; T5b/T5c must implement exact
  immutable reuse without merging independent current evidence. Regression and scatter already reuse call-site styles, but
  regression still requires focused exact point/line/fill glyph evidence.
- Boxplot, density, and sampled Violin/Raincloud each have an explicit
  Renderer-invariant clipping/order record. The Violin raw-overlay body-width
  reconstruction is independently recorded rather than hidden inside final
  overlay application.
- `PointStyle::new` currently supplies Circle, opacity `0.82`, and the default
  white outline at `0.1 * radius`; it is not plain. Raw overlays and mandatory
  raincloud strips remain separate semantic roles despite sharing that helper.
  The target resolves each semantic role before applying the point-outline
  policy, including mandatory-strip legend glyphs; the current constructor
  bypass is intentional correction evidence.
  Strip fit uses radius only and ignores the outline overhang, which remains
  intentional correction evidence. The sampled-Raincloud raw-overlay branch and
  application are separately recorded as dormant and removed rather than made
  into a second reachable observation layer.
- Boxplot and violin whisker semantics intentionally differ: boxplot chooses
  nearest in-fence observations and exposes outside values as fliers, while
  violin uses inclusive filtered folds clamped to quartiles and has no flier
  role. Their equal `1.5*IQR` literals do not justify merging. Density's
  zero-width stroke is a no-outline sentinel; the target uses complete fill
  paint with explicit outline absence while preserving intended pixels.
- Sampled and precomputed raincloud centers, repeated body widths, baselines,
  cloud widths/topologies, summary-box and median geometry/styles, strip bands,
  planning radii, fit rules, and style sources remain independent current records.
  T2h fixes the shared target owners and T5c evidence must prove parity and
  complete paint-bound fit while removing duplicate implementation sources.
- Point-layer label font, paint, size, and origin clamp require intentional
  correction evidence. Current `GeometryBackend` already records estimated
  anchored text bounds with annotation collision weight, and the fixed gap shifts
  those bounds through the draw coordinates. The family string itself does not
  affect current bounds; final size, anchor, and rotation do. `TypographyTheme`
  owns complete appearance; `AnnotationTheme` owns only the non-text gap. Anchor,
  rotation, visibility consequence, and validated placement remain renderer
  invariants.

  and introduces no guide-count ceiling. `LinePattern` retains one closed
  private conversion and the exact `5 3` dash spelling for guides and T2f
  interaction connector/legend-line consumers.

  therefore inventories exactly **1155** records through T2e.
- Independent source-partition, ownership, behavior, schema, count, class,

## T2f: Specialized Marks And Annotations

**Status**: COMPLETE

This section inventories specialized marks, annotations, renderer-local guides,
self-managed plot layouts, and their final style, fit, topology,
policy-application, and draw consequences. Public declarations and exact fields
remain T2b-owned; generic layout remains T2c-owned; generic legend mechanics
remain T2d-owned; ordinary marks remain T2e-owned; semantic domains, target
resolution, and data-color mappings remain T2g-owned. This completed inventory

| ThemePalette fields, preset literals, current palette reads, point-outline policy, and foundational font constants | T2a1/T2b | Inputs and relationships only. T2f admits distinct specialized roles, local assembly/application, and demonstrated cross-role bypasses without duplicating declarations. |
| Private style and geometry carriers, backend validation, clipping, geometry recording, scene conversion, serialization, and lifecycle | T2a2-T2a4 | Terminal consumers and evidence only; T2f owns renderer-local values, immutable plan materialization, and final specialized application. |
| Public plot inputs, annotation and significance declarations, exact style fields, controls, policies, title controls, limits, ticks, statuses, capabilities, and validators | T2b | Declarations remain prior-owned. T2f records only reachable policy applications, private compatibility/validation/materialization, generated content, and rendering consequences. |
| Generic ranges, projection, panel construction, axes, ticks, text measurement, title blocks, and reserve negotiation | T2c | Calls are consumers. T2f owns specialized extents, post-generic fallbacks, self-managed layouts, fit requirements, and final geometry around them. |
| Legend identity, representation, equality, measurement, generic placement, collision, composition, and drawing | T2d | T2f owns originating specialized glyph styles, exact reuse/reconstruction, local glyph grammar, and Matrix policy/box handoff only. |
| Ordinary marks and private LinePattern conversion | T2e | T2f records relative specialized draw order and interaction consumers but creates no second ordinary-mark or conversion owner. |
| Exact coefficient target-to-term lookup, Heatmap identity lookup/normalization, and resolved Histogram dimensions/semantic labels | T2g | T2f consumes resolved identities and labels. It owns post-resolution coefficient guards, active missing-entry scanning, and default-title precedence, not semantic identity resolution. |

### Rejected T2f Matches

| Source match | Disposition and reason |
| --- | --- |
| Imports, derives, documentation, comments, diagnostics, module wiring, accessor forwarding, and carriers without independent behavior | Language, transport, or non-visual context. |
| Caller values, source-row payloads, labels, panel dimensions, and exact scientific coordinates | Input or scientific payload; fixed validation, representation, fit, topology, style, and ordering rules are admitted separately. |
| Data extraction, routine equal-length and finite parsing checks, normalized-string parsing, and error-message prose | Data validity or diagnostics, except visible topology/range/readiness consequences and rendered generated content explicitly admitted above. |
| Exact coefficient target-to-term lookup and Heatmap category/null-row identity lookup or normalization | T2g identity/domain ownership; T2f retains only renderer consequences after exact resolution. |
| Public exact-style declarations, defaults, and validators encountered while tracing final styles | Prior-owned by T2b; private conversion, exact-over-theme materialization, and final application remain renderer invariants rather than new Exact element style records. |
| Palette reads, mapped RGB values, generic layout calls, legend constructors, and backend primitive calls by themselves | Prior T2a/T2c/T2d/T2g consumers; a T2f row requires a distinct specialized role, local value, branch, geometry, fit, reuse, or final responsibility. |
| Test modules, helpers, examples, snapshots, expected errors, and generated SVG | Evidence only, never property sources. |
| Compatibility aliases, schema versions, old/new dispatch, dynamic fallback, and renderer-local defaults after target resolution | Rejected; the target has one current contract and one complete resolved value before measurement or geometry. |

- The T2h-reconciled T2f inventory is exactly **509** records, attributed as
  31/3/9/2/73/45/23/46/38/62/18/18/35/55/13/1/1/16/15/2/2/1 across F-M1
  through F-M22.

  policy**, and **368 Renderer invariant**. Theme data scale, Plot-local data
  scale, and Exact element style remain zero; no keyed row is assigned more
  than one class.
- T2a remains the carrier, backend, serialization, lifecycle, and foundational palette owner. T2b remains the public declaration, exact-field, presence, and policy-declaration owner. T2c remains the generic range, projection, axes, text-layout, and reserve owner. T2d remains the generic legend and rectangle-collision owner. T2e remains the ordinary-mark and private line-pattern conversion owner. T2g retains data semantic identities, coefficient/Heatmap target resolution, order, gradients, resolved semantic labels, and complete data-color mappings; H-M4/H-M5 own general significance rendered-target/facet-panel resolution.
- F-M5 now includes `guides.heatmap.missing-entry-presence`, which owns the active-cell missing scan that drives guide reserve, fit, and swatch presence while Heatmap identity/domain construction remains T2g-owned.
- F-M6 now includes `histogram.binning.nonconstant-range-representability` and separate Explicit-policy rows for default x- and y-title precedence. The superseded renderer-grammar row is absent; resolved dimension and semantic-label inputs remain T2g-owned.
- F-M8 no longer treats coefficient target-to-term lookup as a renderer property. Exact target identity resolution is T2g-owned; T2f retains target-shape validation, post-resolution one-per-term cardinality, glyph materialization, and status compatibility.
- Intentional migration corrections remain explicit: final-face and final-weight text measurement, immutable reserve/draw plans, complete paint-bound fit, sparse interaction run segmentation, Marginal and Matrix clamp/fallback removal, exact Matrix frame and legend policy application, heatmap composited contrast, coefficient adjacent-content conflict handling, and bounded significance range search.
- Equal literals and related helpers are not merged by value. The completed T2h relationship matrix proves each shared target owner/consumer order or explicitly retains independent sample/precomputed, mark/legend, orientation, interval/point, range, and text-plan semantics.
- T2a contributes 222 records, T2b 261, T2c 177, T2d 292, and T2e 203. The

- Independent source-partition, ownership, behavior, schema, count, class,

#### T2g Part A Findings

- The exact-map helper performs lazy per-use completeness, not complete-domain
  preflight, and it accepts an untyped caller-supplied `label`. Later consumer
  groups must prove whether every call passes raw identity or a normalized or
  display-derived string.
- Exact-map presence is atomic at the helper: a missing key errors and never
  falls through. Exact-map absence selects the current theme palette branch.
- The default palette branch cycles with modulo and has no local empty-palette
  guard. The approved target instead validates capacity and never cycles.
- Raw category values are dictionary keys before display normalization. Current
  whitespace collapse can therefore make distinct raw identities display alike
  while exact-map lookup still distinguishes them; prior label collision checks
  do not by themselves prove every consumer uses the same raw/display boundary.
- First-observed order exists at two independent sources: the complete
  `CategoryValues` dictionary and filtered `stable_levels`/collective scans.
  Optional retained rows can narrow the latter, so later facet coordination must
  prove one complete parent-Plot color domain before slicing.
- Unified-series families intentionally route one raw series field through both
  hue and group. Same-field collapse validates row-wise value equality rather
  than relying only on matching field names.
- These sources contain one exact categorical-map mapping and one default
  qualitative-palette mapping. They contain no accent-slot source and no
  continuous domain, center, gradient, interpolation, or missing-color source.
- No unresolved target class or owner remains in Part A. Later T2g consumer
  groups still own exact family mappings, domain-to-index production, facet/Canvas
  coordination, accents, and continuous scales.

#### T2g Part B Findings

1. Complete facet color-domain behavior is currently split across G-M5 carrier
   fallbacks, G-M7 parent-data construction, and G-M8 entry-derived refinement.
   The target keeps these source responsibilities distinct: G-M7 constructs the
   complete domain, G-M5 transports it immutably without fallback, and G-M8
   projects visible mark identities for coordinated rendering.
2. G-M5 still permits panel/default fallback when a coordinated value or hue
   index is absent. That is incompatible with one validated resolved scale and
   is an intentional T5d correction, not backward-compatible behavior.
3. G-M8 derives its rendered hue subset from typed legend identities without
   consulting the entry hue-contribution gate, then filters by the parent source
   and performs a second preflight. A supplemental entry can leak into the
   domain when its typed value matches a parent hue, while a visible mark with no
   entry cannot contribute. T5d must collect visible-mark identities
   independently of entry visibility and reuse one immutable domain for marks,
   guides, and legends.
4. G-M9 already establishes the required Canvas ordering skeleton: Shared alone
   unions raw fields in row-major Plot order, and per-Plot legend visibility is
   not a collection gate. Its G-M36 `preflight_hue_levels` input is nevertheless
   entry-derived, so T5d must replace that projection with visible-mark identity
   collection while T2d separately suppresses hidden Plot legend entries.
5. Fixed-palette capacity and exact-map completeness are absent from every
   admitted facet/Canvas coordination path. They must run after the final parent
   or row-major domain is known, identify the owning scale, report
   required/available capacity or missing raw identities, and never cycle or
   substitute.
6. G-M6 validates only the current erased continuous-color family and Beeswarm's
   finite ascending exact limits. Heatmap kind/center, automatic diverging,
   constant-domain, gradient, and guide agreement belong to the complete T5d
   scale preflight assembled with the other T2g manifests.
7. Raw categorical keys are normally preserved by G-M10, but G-M8 and G-M9 can
   fall back to display text for equality. The target removes that fallback so
   aliases and humanization cannot change scale identity. Exact caller titles,
   Canvas root titles, and shared-legend title compatibility remain T2b/T2d;
   T2g owns only canonical semantic title/label coordination.

Every property key appears exactly once in Current State, once in Target State,
and once in Migration And Evidence in identical source order. Manifest,
references, prior/deferred/rejected tables, and the seven findings are non-keyed
context.

#### T2g Ordinary-Plot Findings

- The slice contains exactly **58** records: 6 G-M11, 3 G-M12, 4 G-M13,
  7 G-M14, 5 G-M15, 4 G-M16, 4 G-M17, 5 G-M18, 15 G-M19,
  2 G-M20, 3 G-M21, and 0 G-M22.
- Closed target classes are exactly **58 Renderer invariant** records and zero
  `Theme component`, `Theme data scale`, `Plot-local data scale`,
  `Exact element style`, or `Explicit policy` records. Palette values and public
  scale controls are prior-owned; these sources implement domain, lookup, reuse,
  and slot behavior.
- Every descriptive key occurs exactly once in Current State, Target State, and
  Migration And Evidence, in identical 58-key order. Manifest, reference,
  prior-owned, deferred, rejected, and finding tables are non-keyed audit
  context.
- Direct `% palette.colors.len()` cycling remains in bars, boxplots, density,
  sampled/precomputed distributions, ordinary/grouped lines, supplemental
  PointLayers, and scatter. Empty palettes usually panic; unkeyed scatter alone
  substitutes black. T5d replaces every such path with fixed-capacity rejection
  or deterministic extension, and the target accent palette is independently
  nonempty/extendable. No target path cycles or substitutes.
- Exact-map reach is inconsistent. Sampled/precomputed violin/raincloud and Hue
  LinePath call `categorical_color`; bars, boxplot, density, ordinary Line,
  neutral trajectory/LinePath, and Scatter bypass it. T5d resolves one
  categorical scale for every same-semantic consumer. Exact raw-key maps remain
  distinct from ordered palettes and never supply anonymous accent slots.
- Horizontal sign coloring overrides mark hue/category colors but reuses the
  ordinary hue legend construction. A visible legend can therefore disagree
  with marks, and a one-color palette silently aliases negative to positive.
  T5d gives the retained sign policy an exact two-identity mapping and one
  agreeing glyph path.
- Other admitted renderer pairs currently agree by shared style/helper or by
  matching indices: regression and scatter reuse final styles; Hue LinePath and
  sampled/precomputed raincloud share mapping helpers; ordinary bars, boxplots,
  density, and ordinary/neutral lines reconstruct colors independently and need
  G-T-AGREE evidence during consolidation.
- Current Line conflates categorical palette positions with supplemental accent
  positions: a hued primary reserves the entire resolved hue-domain length,
  including coordinated levels absent locally. The approved target instead lets
  categorical primaries consume no accent slots. Hued-line automatic
  PointLayers intentionally move to accent slot zero; an unkeyed primary still
  consumes slot zero and its first layer consumes slot one. Exact layer colors
  continue to consume their append position.
- G-M22 is a verified zero-record group. `orchestrator/layers.rs` sources no
  accent-slot mapping; assigning one there would duplicate G-M19 and blur the
  T2b/T2c/T2e boundaries.

T2b public controls, T2f specialized styles or geometry, or production sources

| G-L-R | `reserve`; resolved labels or guide identities affect reserved panel/legend space. |
| G-L-C | `collision`; complete identity/mapping validity is checked before geometry or legend use. |
| G-L-G | `geometry`; categorical order or target identity changes projected row/cell/annotation placement. |

| G-T-DOMAIN | Focused target evidence for first-observed order, explicit order, exact raw/display separation, facet stability, and no fallback/substitution. |
| G-T-CATEGORICAL | Focused target evidence for exact maps, ordered palettes, fixed/extendable capacity, no modulo cycling, and mark/legend identity. |
| G-T-CONTINUOUS | Focused target evidence for exact/automatic domains, centers, constant domains, saturation, OKLab interpolation, missing exclusion, and mark/guide identity. |
| G-T-ACCENT | Focused target evidence for unkeyed slot-zero selection independent of categorical domain size and exact-map configuration. |

#### Findings

| ID | Finding | Disposition |
| --- | --- | --- |
| D-F1 | Beeswarm category lookup uses `position(...).unwrap_or(0)`. The miss is unreachable from current locally built levels, but it is still a silent row-zero substitution and cannot survive immutable coordinated-domain resolution. | Replace with one exact index map and terminal missing-key validation in T5d. |
| D-F2 | Heatmap and Beeswarm embed fixed encoded-RGB gradient literals and interpolate channels in encoded RGB. The approved target requires resolved theme/local gradients and fixed OKLab interpolation, so this migration can intentionally change intermediate colors. | Replace in T5d with pinned OKLab/gamut evidence and reviewed snapshots; keep each literal inseparable from its complete current mapping record. |
| D-F3 | Interaction hue lookup uses `.position(...).unwrap_or(0)`. A present hue omitted from a coordinated domain silently takes slot zero, although exact-map lookup still uses the raw key. | Replace with complete exact domain maps and reject missing identities before mark/legend construction. |
| D-F4 | Interaction independently recomputes the categorical color for marks and legend glyphs. The expressions currently agree, but equality depends on duplicated resolution rather than one frozen color. | Deduplicate in T5d/T5b/T5c and assert exact immutable mark/glyph paint reuse. |
| D-F5 | Marginal iterates local `channels.identities`, performs direct modulo palette lookup, and never calls `resolved_collective_pairs` or `chart.categorical_color`. Coordinated pair order and the advertised exact categorical map are therefore bypassed; unresolved hues also fall back to slot zero. | Correct in T5d with coordinated pair order, exact-map support, explicit capacity behavior, and an accent route when hue is absent. |
| D-F6 | Matrix coordinates pair order but still performs direct modulo palette lookup instead of `chart.categorical_color`; exact categorical maps are ignored and unresolved hues fall back to slot zero. | Correct in T5d with one resolved categorical scale and exact mark/KDE/internal-legend reuse. |
| D-F7 | Point-interval explicit ordering sorts unknown rows with `usize::MAX` after a helper is expected to prove completeness. This is a latent sentinel fallback rather than an exact rank invariant. | Replace with a complete exact rank map and terminal validation in T5d. |
| D-F8 | Waterfall maps negative values through `palette.colors[1 % len]`; a one-color palette collapses increase/decrease identity and an empty palette fails. The sign roles are semantic marks, not anonymous cycling slots. | Replace with validated `MarkTheme` increase/decrease roles in T5c/T5d; preserve `delta >= 0` zero classification. |
